title: Escalate support tickets through tiers
description: Support tickets have a severity level (1 = basic, 2 = technical, 3 = critical). L1Support handles severity 1, L2Support handles severity 2, L3Support handles severity 3. Each handler resolves tickets it can handle and escalates the rest. Implement the three handlers so they form a chain.
hints: SupportHandler is an abstract class — concrete handlers implement handle(Ticket)
Each handler checks the ticket's severity against what it can handle
If the severity is too high and there is no next handler, throw an IllegalStateException
issues: Without a chain, a dispatcher must know every tier's capabilities and update whenever tiers change
Tickets that span multiple tiers require complex routing logic in a single place
overallGoal: Use the Chain of Responsibility pattern so each support tier only knows what it can handle and who to escalate to, keeping routing logic out of a central dispatcher.
goals: Define an abstract SupportHandler with setNext() and a handle() method
Implement L1Support, L2Support, and L3Support each resolving their severity and forwarding the rest
Chain the handlers and throw an exception for any ticket no handler resolves
